newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Power pylons toppled by dynamite in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Power pylons toppled by dynamite in Philippines.

text.p: Unidentified men used dynamite to blast three power pylons of the National Power Corp (Napocor) in the southern Philippines in the latest of a series of attacks on the state firm, officials said on Wednesday.
Two of the pylons were blown up on Monday while the third was destroyed on Wednesday in two villages of Lanao del Sur province, 800 kms (500 miles) south of Manila, Napocor spokesman Pete Chung said.
There have been eight other attacks so far this year.
The destruction of the pylons reduced electricity supply to nine provinces, he said. Six other Napocor pylons in the area were destroyed in previous attacks this year.
Police said the saboteurs could either be Moslem separatist guerrillas, dismissed workers or residents demanding right-of-way compensation after Napocor built the pylons on their farms.
